allocation.algorithm: Family groups sorted by decreasing eligible-trial count, decreasing positive-record count, seeded SHA-256 tie-break. Greedy minimum summed squared relative deviations in total trials, eligible trials and positives; split-order tie-break.

evaluation.aggregation: query micro, owner-trial macro (within owner then equal trials), and family macro (within family then equal families); report single/multi-owner strata
evaluation.latency: separate query encoding and ranking; report one-time candidate preparation; no LLM/Neo4j time mixed into ranking
evaluation.model_selection: validation only, frozen test once; no model selection performed
evaluation.recall: Known registered owners in top-k divided by all known owners; distinct from Hit@k
evaluation.tie_break: descending score then ascending NCT ID
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired family-cluster bootstrap; 1000 replicates, fixed seed; identical sampled families for methods; not run

family_screen.exact_strong: Exact punctuation-normalized title >=30 characters and >=5 words
family_screen.near: Shared non-generic title token >=4 characters occurring in 2..80 trials; title length ratio>=0.8; SequenceMatcher>=0.90
family_screen.near_strong: Similarity>=0.95 plus a shared lead sponsor or non-generic intervention; still UNRESOLVED
family_screen.not_evidence_of_identity: Generic condition, sponsor or outcome strings alone are never family proof
family_screen.rejected: Prior explicit REJECTED classifications are preserved, never inferred from differing sponsors
family_screen.weak: Unresolved weak endpoints and their grouped families are quarantined from held-out evaluation

graph_policy.regime: Trial-disjoint supervision within an observed non-target graph; NOT unseen-trial inductive evaluation

limitations: Full-cohort protocol/secondary identifiers unavailable in this extraction; family screen is not exhaustive.
New automated family and near-query candidates are not human-reviewed clinical equivalences.
Snapshot may include amendments; no original-registration or prospective clinical claims.
Training-loader isolation is an API boundary, not operating-system access control.
No embeddings, message passing, training or ranking evaluation performed.

negative_policy.caution: Unlinked does not imply clinically irrelevant; no held-out truth is consulted by the loader
exclude: all known training owners of exact query
training owners of screened near queries
negative_policy.sampling: Future fixed-seed uniform/hard mixture must be declared before training; no negatives sampled in this stage

query_policy.description_screen: Exact normalized groups and bounded near screen (max 2000 chars); audit only because descriptions are not model inputs
query_policy.embargo: Exact cross-partition query groups, cross-partition near candidates, or weak-family quarantine; no clinical equivalence inferred
query_policy.near_screen: Punctuation-key groups plus adjacent lexically sorted strings, 30..800 chars, length ratio>=0.9 and SequenceMatcher>=0.95; non-exhaustive
query_policy.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse only
query_policy.positives: All exact-normalized registered owners, not clinical-equivalence labels

task: Registered planned-outcome measure-to-trial association ranking; not clinical outcome prediction
